poll_info.title: NuggMD Cannabis Consumer Poll - Q1 2026 Omnibus
poll_info.methodology: Digital questionnaire sent to opt-in list of verified cannabis consumers via NuggMD.com first-party data

questions.question_text: Which best describes your relationship with home cannabis cultivation?
What are the barriers preventing you from growing cannabis at home?
questions.question_note: Conditional question - asked only to respondents who answered 'I have never grown, but I would if barriers were removed' to Question 1. Multi-select; percentages based on 129 respondents and do not sum to 100%.

questions.question_text: In some areas, hemp THC products are available at stores and shops that are not regulated cannabis dispensaries. Do you believe these hemp THC products are of a higher quality, of a lower quality, or of the same quality compared to dispensary cannabis?
How do you feel about each of the following methods of consuming cannabis?
Which best describes how you approach cannabis purchasing?
How much would cannabis prices need to increase before you changed your purchasing behavior?
questions.question_note: Conditional question - asked only to respondents who answered 'I balance price and quality roughly equally' or 'I prioritize finding the lowest price for an acceptable product' to Question 5.

demographics.population: Representative sample of cannabis consumers in state-legal markets
demographics.sample_method: Sourced from independent providers of verified consumer data and first-party data
demographics.verification: Regular cannabis users. A strong majority of the sample reports daily or weekly cannabis use.
